data.name: Sabeeka
data.long_meaning: One who is in search of or deeply devoted to something, often used for those who are eager to seek knowledge or attain spiritual enlightenment.

in_arabic.name: سبيكة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على المرأة الصالحة والخليطة الطيبة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم سببكة مشتق من الفعل سبك يسبك سبكاً فهو سبوك وسبيكة، ويطلق على المرأة الصالحة والخليطة الطيبة، كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الصافات آية 113، وتدل على المرأة التي تتصف بالصفات الحميدة

in_urdu.name: سبیکہ
in_urdu.meaning: ایک ایسے شخصیت کی خصوصیت ہے جو اچھے اخلاق کی مالک ہو
in_urdu.long_meaning: سبیکہ کا نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے اچھے اخلاق کی مالک، یا خلیطہ طیبہ، یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے، اور اس کا ذکر قرآن کریم میں الصافات سورة میں کیا گیا ہے

in_hindi.name: सबीका
in_hindi.meaning: यह नाम एक अच्छी और नेक इंसान की विशेषता को दर्शाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: सबीका नाम का अर्थ है अच्छी और नेक इंसान, या अच्छी शील की महिला, यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है, और इसका उल्लेख कुरआन में सूरा अस-साफात में किया गया है, यह नाम अच्छे गुणों की विशेषता को दर्शाता है

in_pashto.name: سبيکا
in_pashto.meaning: د ښځې د نیکۍ او ښایسته ځانګړتیا نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: سبيکا نوم د ښځې د نیکۍ او ښایسته ځانګړتیا لپاره کارول کیږي، دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، او د قرآن کریم د الصافات سورت په 113 آیت کې ورته اشاره شوې ده

in_english.name: Sabeeka
in_english.meaning: A woman of good character and pious
in_english.long_meaning: The name Sabeeka originates from Arabic roots, signifying a woman of good character, pious, and a good mixer. It is mentioned in the Quran, Surah As-Saaffat, verse 113. The name embodies positive personality traits such as righteousness, piety, and good manners. Sabeeka is used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing the importance of moral integrity and spiritual devotion

data.cultural_impact: The name Sabeeka holds a significant cultural impact, as it reflects the idea of active pursuit and dedication to learning or spiritual growth. In the Islamic tradition, learning and seeking knowledge is highly valued, and the term "Sabeek" or "Sabeeka" is often used to describe individuals who are deeply engaged in the pursuit of knowledge or spiritual development. This name can be inspiring and motivating for individuals who are striving to improve themselves and advance in their personal and spiritual journeys.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Sabeeka carries great significance as it signifies a profound sense of devotion and dedication to Allah (God) and the pursuit of His pleasure. The word "Sabeek" (male) or "Sabeeka" (female) can be seen as a reflection of the prophetic hadith in which Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) advised Muslims to "seek knowledge even as far as China,” emphasizing the importance of education and knowledge in the Islamic tradition. The name Sabeeka can serve as a constant reminder for individuals to remain focused and committed to their spiritual objectives and to strive towards attaining nearness to Allah through continuous learning and growth.
